title: Listing Packages
description: Manage service packages that providers offer for their listings.

help.title: About Listing packages
help.overview: A package is a priced tier on a listing — for example Basic, Standard, or Premium. When a buyer orders with a package, that package's price and delivery days replace the listing's base price for the order.

sections.title: What you set
items: Name and optional description describe the tier.
Price amount and currency are what the order charges when this package is chosen.
Delivery days become the order's due-date window (add-ons may still add days).
Display order sorts packages on the listing (lower first).
Listing and provider are fixed when the package is created.

sections.title: How it sits with the listing
items: A listing can have many packages; none are required to activate the listing.
Ordering without a package uses the listing base price and delivery days.
Soft delete removes the package from offers; it can be restored.
